kd.teacher_instruct_template: Given a memory note, retrieve similar notes
kd.kd_target: first 384 dims of precomputed 1024-d fp32 vectors (lockstep npz, train rows then val rows)
kd.precompute: lockstep over all 26681 texts, batch 32, torch threads 8, interop 1, bf16 (round-4 recipe), RESUMABLE: incremental partial-npz every 500 batches

contrastive.mechanics: symmetric in-batch InfoNCE, pair-adjacent batches of 16 pairs (32 texts), partner = i^1, cosine logits / tau, on the full 384-d projected L2-normalised embedding (pilot mechanics verbatim)
contrastive.positives: translation pairs of the r5 corpus: translated-llm-r4 + translated-real-r4 + translated-dup + twins + tatoeba (750 inline pairs); NOT translated-sibling (contrast pairs per gate builder note)
contrastive.pair_pool_rule: build_gate_set.py pairing recipe verbatim (real/llm via gen key match; seed-dup inline side_text_seed; twin inline; pair_key dedup first-occurrence), both sides in the r5 TRAIN slice under the expected source class, one-pair-per-text; gate-manifest excluded_text_shas asserted ZERO hits (corpus is already clean)
contrastive.batch_layout: PARTITION design: each epoch = (a) KD-only batches over non-pair train texts (batch 32, round-4 loop unchanged), then (b) joint KD+contrastive pair-adjacent batches over the pair pool (16 pairs per batch). Every train text trains exactly once per epoch; pair texts get the pilot joint loss.
contrastive.stream_order: fixed: stream (a) then stream (b), both deterministically shuffled per epoch (seeded rng)

optimization.early_stop: val criterion = min-over-slices R@5; stop when best-so-far improves by <0.001 for 4 consecutive evals (prereg §1.4, fixed before start)

checkpoint_selection.protocol: S1m-val on the full val slice (1261 queries), relevance = frozen teacher-top5 (384-d teacher slice), computed from the same precomputed npz as the KD targets
checkpoint_selection.criterion: max min-over-MRL-slices R@5 (slices 64/128/256/384, student truncated+renormalised vs teacher slice truncated+renormalised; relevance from the frozen 384-d teacher-top5)
checkpoint_selection.forbidden: judged corpus c2ce056d, cortex sealed holdouts/evalsets — never read before export+selection
checkpoint_selection.monitoring_only: per-epoch gate-set proxy (seed-dup/llm/real/twin medians, mono control, burned144) recorded for trend (prereg §4.3), NEVER used for selection

forms_measured: fp32 ONNX (exactness reference vs torch, round-4 evidence: identical)

int8 static QDQ CALIBRATED: per-channel weight quantization, MinMax calibration over 512 deterministic train-corpus samples (stratified by source family, seed 42) — the round-4 failure (200 val samples, per-channel=False) is corrected on both axes
int8 dynamic (weight-only, activation scales at runtime)
export.choice_rule_fixed_before_measurement: among forms with g6a mean <= 45 ms: hard guards |delta mono control median vs prod 0.8982| <= 0.005 AND val min-over-slices R@5 within 0.005 of the fp32 reference; among survivors max composite = seed_dup_median + llm_median + burned144_median (gate-set proxy readouts); tie-break smaller |delta mono|, then simpler form. Final gates run ONCE on the chosen artifact.
